snippet.title: COVR Gameplay Trailer | Tactical Milsim VR Shooter | Meta Quest, SteamVR
snippet.description:
Wishlist COVR here: https://linktr.ee/xrealgames | COVR is a hardcore tactical milsim focused on tension, stealth, and high-stakes combat. Reloads, attachments, breaching tools, grenades, and tactical equipment all behave the way you’d expect. Engagements are fast and unforgiving - if you expose yourself, miss your timing, or lose control of a room, things can unravel quickly.
